text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time for summer camp, a valuable
opportunity for Umamusume to improve
their skills and develop. Nishino Flower
appears impatient to get
started...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Let's make the most of this camp,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I may have had a disappointing showing
in the
Japanese Oaks, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I just know I can live up to everyone's

expectations in the Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower's enthusiasm is palpable.
And the
thing is, I'm just as motivated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She should be entering a period of rapid 
development soon, when her body begins
transforming gradually from one
of a child into
one of an adult.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once her physical attributes blossom,
she'll finally be able to race at peak
potential. I'll have to
keep searching for
the optimal way to train her...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When you're with me, I feel like... I can
keep
pushing myself to work harder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She does her best for my sake, so now
it's my turn
to guide her along the path
to a successful future.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Phew, what sweltering passion.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You two look so serious even though
camp hasn't
even started yet.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, hi Sky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Can't you hear it, Flower? The sea
breeze calling
our names?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's telling us to take a nap on the
beach!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A nap outdoors?! You could get
heatstroke if
you're not careful!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, there's still time before we start,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I will! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wait up, Sky! I'll bring you a cold drink
and a
towel to lie on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I silently thank Seiun Sky for her subtle
display of
kindness. And with that, our
fiery summer camp
begins!
